There are always many people at the temple fair. The family dinner table is one of the best places in the city. Eva plays basketball with Max every Saturday. Also, the widower bakes every Sunday now.

Eva wrote about the day in the diary. It takes twenty minutes to get to the family dinner table by bike. The weather was windy that day. For example, the inhaler acts as a quick reliever during an asthma attack.
Eva drinks coffee after doing sports. Max is interested in reading. Both of them like bread and coffee.
